title: RuntimeManifest
description: Artifact-side runtime manifest (P5-01 schema; emitted per built artifact by P5-02..P5-07). Identity fields (targetTriple/os/osVersionRange/distro/arch/variant/webviewStrategy/minimumWebview) mirror the build input packaging/targets.json; the remaining fields are only knowable at build/verify time and must never appear in targets.json. After installation the manifest is checkable against the actual files; its trustworthiness comes from the signed release / verified installer, not from merely containing hashes (05-book). Manifests must not contain developer-machine absolute paths or secrets; @xresconv/packaging lintManifest enforces that hygiene rule (PK01).

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this manifest. Breaking changes must bump it.

appVersion.description: Semantic version of the application inside this artifact; equals the <version> segment of the artifact file name.

sourceCommit.description: Full git commit SHA the artifact was built from (lowercase hex).

targetTriple.description: Rust target triple; must match the originating target in packaging/targets.json.

osVersionRange.description: Copied from the originating target; semantics per os are documented in packaging-targets.

distro.description: Present exactly when the originating target carries one (linux bootstrap only).

minimumWebview.description: Copied from the originating target; null for macOS system-only.

runtimePayloads.description: Logical payloads carried by this artifact. Every variant ships one shared Node (node-runtime) plus compiled backend/guardian/script-host JS and production npm modules; webview2-bootstrapper / webview2-offline-installer / linux-selfcontained-runtime only appear on the matching variants.

nodeVersion.description: Exact bundled Node.js version (e.g. 24.21.0); the major must equal the target's nodeVersion input.

source.description: Where the Node binary was obtained (e.g. the nodejs.org dist URL); recorded for reproduction, verified at build time.

moduleTreeHash.description: Hash over the production module tree listing (P5-02 assembly); identical between the two variants of one version on one target (05-book Windows rule 4).

nodeAbi.description: Node-ABI version the bundled native modules were built for.

modules.description: Bundled native modules (e.g. koffi on win32); empty array when the target ships none.

path.description: Path relative to the installed application root; forward slashes, never absolute (lint-enforced).

origin.description: Provenance of the file, e.g. build:<workspace>, node-dist:<version>, npm:<name>@<version>, webview2:<channel>.

license.description: SPDX identifier or license reference; licenses are shipped untrimmed (05-book).

subject.description: What was signed/notarized (installer path, app bundle path, SBOM file name).

reference.description: Where the evidence lives (detached signature file name, notarization log id); produced by the controlled release environment (P5-07).

dirty.description: Release artifacts must be built from a clean tree (dirty=false).

reportPath.description: Index into the release's test/acceptance reports for this artifact (relative path or release asset name).

testedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the verification run.
